description: feature:loans — implement LoanApplicationScreen (F-12) with LoanViewModel (@HiltViewModel + StateFlow) that auto-computes the repayment schedule, and wire it into NangaNavHost replacing the LoansScreen stub. F-12 per wireframe lines ~956-996: score-gated advisory card (green gradient: score + tier + max eligible/rate), loan amount input, purpose dropdown, repayment term toggle (1/3/6 months), repayment schedule card (monthly payment + total interest auto-computed), Apply button. INDEPENDENT of other FEATs (LOANS route constant already exists).
steps: Read /Users/Komarov/Documents/Nanga/NANGA_WIREFRAMES.html lines 956-996 for F-12 markup. Read theme/Color.kt tokens (GreenDeep/GreenMid/GreenLight for advisory gradient, InkDark, Slate, BronzeDeep for accents).

Create feature/loans/src/main/java/com/nanga/feature/loans/LoanUiState.kt: enum LoanTerm { ONE_MONTH, THREE_MONTHS, SIX_MONTHS } with months:Int (1,3,6); data class LoanRecommendation(maxAmountKsh:Int, annualRatePercent:Int, score:Int, tier:String); data class RepaymentSchedule(monthlyPaymentKsh:Int, totalInterestKsh:Int); data class LoanUiState(score:Int, tier:String, recommendation:LoanRecommendation, amountKsh:Int, purpose:String, term:LoanTerm, schedule:RepaymentSchedule?, isSubmitting:Boolean, applied:Boolean).

Create feature/loans/src/main/java/com/nanga/feature/loans/LoanViewModel.kt: @HiltViewModel class LoanViewModel : ViewModel() exposing StateFlow<LoanUiState> seeded with sample (score 672 Silver, max KSh 25,000, rate 8% p.a., amount 15,000, purpose 'Fishing gear', term THREE_MONTHS). Provide setAmount(Int), setPurpose(String), setTerm(LoanTerm), and a private recomputeSchedule() that computes monthly = round(amount/term + interest) and totalInterest = amount*rate%*term/12 (simple), updating state.schedule whenever amount/term change. Provide applyForLoan() setting applied=true.

Create feature/loans/src/main/java/com/nanga/feature/loans/LoanApplicationScreen.kt: @Composable fun LoanApplicationScreen(onBack: () -> Unit, viewModel: LoanViewModel = hiltViewModel()). Layout per F-12: back-arrow TealGradientHeader(title="Loan Application"); advisory card (Box with verticalGradient GreenDeep->GreenMid, White text: 'Score: 672 (Silver)' + 'Max eligible: KSh 25,000 · Rate: 8% p.a.'); 'Loan amount (KSh)' OutlinedTextField bound to setAmount; 'Purpose' ExposedDropdownMenuBox with a couple of options (Fishing gear, Boat repair, Fuel, Nets) bound to setPurpose; 'Repayment term' toggle Row of 3 FilterChip-like toggles bound to setTerm; 'Repayment schedule' card: monthly payment + total interest from state.schedule (bold); primary Button 'Apply for KSh N' -> viewModel.applyForLoan() then onBack. Use MaterialTheme + NangaTheme tokens; RoundedCornerShape 8-12dp. Observe uiState via collectAsStateWithLifecycle().
